name: dupscan.neardup.n_scanned
notes: triggered test windows scanned against train and validation windows; thresholds fixed in advance: correlation above 0.999, maximum absolute difference below 0.01 g

name: dupscan.neardup.n_not_triggered
notes: test events with no window (trigger not passed); not scanned

name: dupscan.neardup.n_both
notes: a single train or validation window meets both thresholds

name: dupscan.neardup.n_corr_only
notes: correlation above the threshold but no pair within the maximum-difference threshold

name: dupscan.neardup.n_diff_only
notes: maximum difference below the threshold but correlation not above it

name: dupscan.neardup.n_both_and_in_leaky_set
notes: near-duplicates that the exact-hash or 32-bin rule already removed from the primary test set

name: dupscan.neardup.n_both_new
notes: near-duplicates NOT removed from the primary test set

name: dupscan.neardup.n_leaky_triggered
notes: triggered test events removed from the primary test set by the exact-hash or nearest-neighbour rule

name: dupscan.neardup.n_both_new.crash
notes: class of the near-duplicate test events not removed

name: dupscan.neardup.n_both_new.near_miss
notes: class of the near-duplicate test events not removed

name: dupscan.neardup.n_both_new.normal
notes: class of the near-duplicate test events not removed

name: dupscan.neardup.max_corr_median
notes: median over triggered test events of the best correlation to a train or validation window

name: dupscan.neardup.min_maxdiff_median_where_within_bound
notes: median over events that have a window within the exact L2 bound; the others have a maximum difference above the threshold
